VW Stops a physical attack.
Reveal the top 3 cards of your Life Deck. Your
opponent chooses 1 of those cards. Place the chosen
card into your hand and the other 2 on top of your
Life Deck in any order. If your MP is level 3 or
higher, you choose the card instead.
